# James Hirata

> James Hirata (平田滋睦) is a Japanese photographer and the Creative Director of Nomado Ltd. He runs destination wedding, property media, lifestyle photography, short stay rental and web design brands across Japan and New Zealand, working between Hokkaido and Kansai in Japan and Queenstown in New Zealand. Solo since 2012, incorporated in 2018, first full time team in 2022, renamed Nomado Ltd in 2023. Japan office moves to Kobe in October 2026.

Site: https://www.jameshirata.com/ (English and Japanese on one page, toggle in the nav)
Contact: james@jameshirata.com

## Brands

- Nomad Weddings New Zealand: https://nomad.wedding/ (helicopter weddings and elopements out of Queenstown, since 2012, up to 205 weddings a year)
- Nomad Weddings Japan: https://nomadweddings.jp/ (elopements and small weddings across 11 locations including Kyoto, Tokyo, Kamakura, Mt Fuji, Naoshima, Miyakojima, Niseko, Otaru, Furano; since 2023; Japanese team fluent in English)
- Queenstown Memories: https://queenstownmemories.co.nz/ (travel and family photography in Queenstown and Wanaka)
- Niseko Memories: https://nisekomemories.jp/ (travel and family photography in Niseko)
- Property Media Japan: real estate photography, video, drone and AI assisted HDR editing for agents selling Japanese property to overseas buyers (contact by email)
- Real Estate Consulting, Japan: buying, renovating and running property in Japan as a non resident, Hokkaido and Kansai focus (contact by email)
- Ski Vacation Rentals: short stay homes in Queenstown (https://majestichomesqt.holidayfuture.com/listings/564788) and Otaru
- Web Marketing and Design: design, build, SEO, structured data and deployment for travel, hospitality and property brands that need to rank in English and Japanese

## Facts

- Started Nomad Weddings New Zealand in Wellington in 2012 as a solo freelance wedding photographer; moved to Auckland 2014, Queenstown 2019
- Company incorporated as James Hirata Photography Ltd in 2018; renamed Nomado Ltd in 2023
- Queenstown team of six, Japan team of three with planners in Kyoto, Tokyo, Niseko and Okinawa
- Clients from more than 20 countries
- Press: The Japan Times, NHK News, TV Asahi Hatori Morning Show, Nikkei, Zexy Overseas Wedding
